_comment: The reshipment roster: which brand-marketplaces the unattended run covers,
and which Seller Central region each one is reached through. This file is the
single source of truth. It used to be duplicated as a ROSTER string inside
biweekly_preflight.sh and again in whatever ad-hoc harness drove a run, which
is how Pawsan sat enabled in the vault while the automation never planned it.
Planning inputs (coverage days, lead time, minimums) deliberately do NOT live
here. They live in each client's team-vault 'Amazon Ops.md' so a timing change
is a vault edit and takes effect on the next run with no code change. An
account whose vault profile has reshipment.enabled false is skipped and named.
region groups the accounts by Seller Central host, because one login serves a
whole region and the runs are scheduled per region. Regions run in parallel;
accounts inside a region run one at a time, so two accounts never fight over
awd is Amazon Warehousing & Distribution, a US-only program. Requesting it on
a non-US marketplace makes the provider return status 'partial' with awd null,
which on 11.08.2026 looked exactly like a hard failure and dropped JBS DE and
Svens Island AU from the run.
